title: FabricConformancePolicy v1 — the fabric conformance kit's law as data: every check in the kit's fixed suite is required (all_checks_required always true — a candidate may not pick the checks it likes) and every check runs on a fresh instance from the candidate's factory (fresh_instance_per_check always true — no check may pass on another check's leftovers); candidate names the transport under examination and simulated is the caller's honest declaration about its wiring, carried verbatim into the report because the kit cannot see past the factory seam (Y-069)
